# Itinerary formatting skill

Format the final answer as a compact day plan: outbound train, attraction and daytime activity, return train, and total cost in GBP. Include the selected candidate ID in the machine response. Use the observed fixture times and prices, and say when an attraction is open on Saturday.

Do not include credentials, hidden reasoning, unsupported claims, or unbounded extra destinations. Keep the itinerary readable and under the contract text limit.
